remarks: Embrace Loft Living at Its Best in the Heart of SONO!  Tucked on a quiet, private street yet just moments from everything SONO offers, this striking space blends contemporary style with everyday ease. The modern kitchen showcases stainless steel counters and appliances, plus a butcher block island designed for both entertaining and cooking. Towering ceilings, polished concrete, rich hardwood floors, and an expansive wall of windows fill the home with light and character.  Enjoy a layout that feels both dramatic and inviting, perfect for hosting friends or enjoying quiet nights in. The open-concept design highlights the loft's industrial-chic vibe, while warm wood tones add a sense of home.   Key features include:  *In-unit laundry  *Generous storage  *Elevator building  *Private garage parking just steps from your entry. One parking space included with unit. (One additional space available at additional charge.)  Step outside and immerse yourself in SONO's thriving community. You're just minutes from the waterfront, marinas, award-winning restaurants, artisan coffee shops, unique boutiques, and the SONO Collection Mall. With Metro North nearby, commuting is effortless. This rare loft combines the ultimate in style, location, and convenience-a must-see for those seeking something truly special!
